comment: Our exercise catalogue, written by hand. build_catalogue.py checks it and writes app/src/main/assets/exercises/exercises.json. One exercise per line. wger: the wger exercise it follows (null when none fits); text: 'wger' copies wger's English instructions, 'none' copies nothing. legacy: the ids the owner's history uses today (TrainingPlanData).
